Exact rational diagnostic passed, but not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The model explicitly parametrizes nonlinear dynamics using A=BB*, but for rank-one A the entire freedom in B changes the effective gain. Proving all invariant probabilities and constructing two identical-A factors with globally incompatible extinction and entropy gives a sharp identifiability obstruction in a physically motivated matrix coupling, not a mere numerical threshold or relabeling. Scope is a natural complete rank-one classification; general-rank extension is not claimed.
